title: Topic 20
japanese_text:
A：最近、目が<u>かすむ</u>んだよね。肩もすごく<u>凝る</u>し…。
B：え、大丈夫？肩、もんであげよっか？
A：や、遠慮しとく。くすぐったくてだめなんだよね。
english_translation: A: My vision has been blurring lately. My shoulders are also very stiff ... B: Oh, are you all right? Do you want me to rub your shoulders? A: No, thanks. I'm ticklish.
